sum: Pixelworks, Inc. provides content creation, video delivery, and display processing solutions, and technology in the United States. The company's products and technology include TrueCut Motion Platform, a content creation software tools; and develops other cinematic visualization solutions. It also offers licensing and services for content creation, remastering and video streaming, and display of cinematic video. Pixelworks, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Portland, Oregon.
ceo: Mr. Todd A. DeBonis (President, CEO & Chairman)
